transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I keep having these moments where my own house or my office feels unreal. It’s like I’m watching myself from across the room instead of actually being there.
During those moments, do you know that the house only feels unreal, or do you believe it actually has changed in some way?
I know it only feels unreal. I don’t think the house has actually changed—it’s more like I’m not fully there, or I’m watching myself from a distance.
When these unreal or out-of-body moments happen, do they come with a sudden surge of intense fear or panic?
I’m not sure I’d call it panic. It’s more that I notice the unreal feeling and it throws me off for a moment.
Do these unreal feelings happen only when you’re around one particular thing or situation that you’re afraid of?
No, I wouldn’t say it’s tied to one particular thing. It can happen at home or at the office—places that should feel normal to me.
When these episodes happen, do you suddenly get a racing heart?
I haven’t really noticed my heart racing when it happens. I’m usually more aware of that strange unreal feeling.
